sources.title: DDEX — ERN implementation guidance and best practice (index)
sources.author: DDEX

keyExcerpts.content: Guidance and best-practice articles for ERN, browsable by category
keyExcerpts.relevance: The index this router is built from; every routed link is one of its entries.

sources.notes: Sole structural source. The router reproduces titles and links from this index; it does not reproduce article content.

claims.claim: DDEX publishes an ERN implementation-guidance index whose articles are grouped into the categories reproduced here.
claims.locator: Index page category structure and article links
claims.verificationNote: Categories are taken from the KB's own URL hierarchy, not invented.

claims.claim: 209 guidance articles across 11 problem areas are routed here, and every link in this skill returned HTTP 200 on 2026-08-23.
claims.locator: Link check of all 217 distinct URLs in SKILL.md
claims.verificationNote: All 217 distinct kb.ddex.net URLs checked individually. Initial parallel checking produced false failures from rate limiting; re-run at lower concurrency with retries returned 200 for every URL.

claims.claim: This skill makes no assertion about the content of any routed article.
claims.locator: By construction — the skill body contains only article titles and links
claims.verificationNote: Deliberate design choice after a refutation pass on ddex-sources found 4 of 10 paraphrased standard descriptions materially wrong.

areas.area: Allowed value sets and code lists

checkStatuses.verified: HTTP 200 to an automated check on accessedDate

scopeGaps.topic: Guidance for standards other than ERN (DSR, MWN, RDR, CDM, RIN, MWL, LOD, BWARM, MLC)
scopeGaps.reason: Present in the same DDEX index but out of scope for a delivery-focused router. ddex-sources routes to the standards themselves.

scopeGaps.topic: What any routed article actually says
scopeGaps.reason: Deliberately not asserted. See claim c3.

verificationPass.method: Structural: every routed URL individually HTTP-checked; categories derived from the KB's own URL hierarchy rather than authored.
verificationPass.caveat: Claude built this router and ran the link check. The claim surface is deliberately minimal — three structural claims, no assertions about article content — which is what makes a non-independent pass tolerable here in a way it was not for ddex-sources.
